title: Time Leverage
hook: When I stop working, my income stops. That's the real problem.
statement: Build work that keeps paying after you're done.
explainer: Trading hours one for one caps you at your calendar. Templates don't sleep.
sop: Tag every hour: manual or leveraged.
Delegate the lowest value manual tasks.
Turn one repeat task into a template.
equation_example: Output $8,000 ÷ Time 20 hours = $400 an hour. Raise it without adding hours.
question: Name one task you could record once and reuse.
